items.title: Role of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analysis (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Role of Hypothesis Testing in Data Analysis' under topic 7.1 (PDF 94, printed 90).

blocks.text: Hypothesis testing data ko mantiqi (logical) tareeqe se analyze karne mein madad deti hai, taake pata chale ke nataij ba-maani (meaningful) hain ya nahi. Testing be-tarteeb (random) nateejon se bachati hai. Yeh nataij ko tawaqqo (expectation) se milati hai. Hypothesis testing durusti (accuracy) barhati hai aur experiments aur surveys mein use hoti hai. Faisle saboot par hote hain, aur is tareeqe se nataij par aitmad (confidence) barhta hai.
Mukhtasar khulasa: 7.1 Introduction to Hypothesis Testing

items: Hypothesis testing: data se faisla ke koi assumption sach hai ya ghalat.
Hypothesis: testing se pehle bana wazeh aur measurable bayan.
Pehle research question, phir us se hypothesis.
